text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.Today, we'll be exploring the grammar activity of Unit 3, food and ethics.To be more specific, we will review the passive in different forms.By the end of this period, you are expected to recognize the passive in different forms in a given context, understand the meaning and uses of different passive forms, and use the passive in different forms correctly in the activity.Before class, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.In the previous lesson, you have read about sharks.For the first question,Yes.It's body was thrown over the side of the boat.For the second question,As you may remember,In both sentences, passive forms are used.So today, let's have a grammar review of the passive used in different forms.First, let's read a passage about how the exploration of the sea helps the production of the electronics.When you are reading, underline the passive forms in the passage and number them.You will have one minute.Have you got them?What are the passive forms in the passage?Here is my work.Compare your answers with mine.Next, match the number of the passive forms to grammar items A to G in the table.Now, check the answers in the table by yourself.Then, you will have one minute.I'm going to do a left turn.I'm going to do a right turn.Now, I'm going to make a left turn.check the answers in the table by yourself.You must check the answers in the table by yourself.Have you got them right?Do you notice there is one passive structure that is missing from the table?Yes, It is number 9.What grammar item does No.9 expect billions to be made represent?Actually, it is the passive form of the infinitive to do.So we know non-finite verbs can also have passive forms.Now let's practice.Read a passage about how our lifestyle has an impact on rainforests and fill in the blanks with proper forms of the verbs.Pay attention to the time clues to determine the proper tenses.You will have two minutes for the task.Let's discuss the answers together for blank 1.For blank 1, the modal verb can should be followed by the passive form in the present.Thus, the beef and trainers may come from cattle that can be traced back to a rainforest.For blank 12, clue words soon indicate that we should use passive form in the future.Thus, some leather products will be certified deforestation free.For blanks 2 and 4, the clue words today and in recent years both indicate a time period up to now.So, we should use the passive in the present perfect.Half of the words rainforests have been destroyed and three quarters of this destruction has been caused by cattle ranching.For blanks 3 and 7, the clue words at the moment indicates an ongoing unfinished action.So, we should use the passive in the present continuous.Thus, trees are being cut down illegally and satellite images are being used by environmental organizations.For blanks 8, 9 and 10, the clue words last year, marked and showed all indicate the past.Thus, we can use the passive form in the past.Last year, pictures of Brazilian cattle ranches were compared with maps which marked their legal boundaries.The pictures showed that a lot of the protected forests had been cleared away and some ranches were prosecuted as a result.For blank 5, it talks about a general situation.So, we use the passive form in a simple present.For every cow raised, an area of rainforest the size of two football fields is destroyed.For blank 6, the verb avoid takes gerund doing as its object.So, we need to use its passive form being caught here.For blank 11, the verb expect takes the infinitive to do as an object.So, we should use to be protected here.Now, do you have a clearer idea of how to use those passive structures appropriately?Now, let's practice using passive structures in translation.Please translate these sentences into English with the appropriate tenses and passive forms.You will have three minutes.现在,我们一起讨论一条文章。第一条文章,这里的菜烧得很好,还有免费蛋糕供应。从这条文章,我们知道,菜烧得很好,应该是翻译成,这里的菜烧得很好,还有免费蛋糕供应。第二条文章,这里的菜烧得很好,还有免费蛋糕供应。勤洗手是避免疾病传染的有效方法之一。We know 避免疾病传染 should be translated in the passive form.We can say avoid being infected by disease.So the whole sentence can be,washing hands regularly is one of the effective ways to avoid being infected by disease.Did you translate it correctly?The third sentence,由于天气恶劣,航班延误了好几个小时。Here,航班延误 should be translated in the passive form.The flight was delayed or has been delayed.So for the whole sentence, we can say,The flight was delayed or has been delayed for a couple of hours.What about the fourth sentence?马克在哪里?他在面试一个新工作。Here,他在面试一个新工作 should be translated in the passive form.He is being interviewed for a new job.So the whole sentence goes,Where is Mark?In the fifth sentence,当时文件正在打印。我不得不等了几分钟。How do you translate 文件正在打印?Yes, it should be translated in the passive form.The papers were being printed out.So we can say,The papers were being printed out at that moment.So I had to wait for a few minutes.For the last sentence,我到达晚宴派对时,东西都被吃光了。Here,东西都被吃光了 should be translated in the passive form,In the past perfect,Everything had been eaten.So the whole sentence is,When I arrived at the dinner party,Everything had been eaten.Did you get them right?Next, look around your surroundings and think of things you can describe with the passive structure.Write three sentences in different tenses.You can refer to the examples in the table.Here are three sentences written by my students.The window was repaired last week.Here, was repaired is passive in the past.The classroom is being decorated for the cultural festival.Is being decorated is passive in the present.Five seats for the new students will be added at the back of the classroom.Will be added is passive in the future.All the passive forms are used correctly in the real-life situations.Here are my sentences.The flowers are watered by the gardener every week.The homework has been collected and given to the teacher.When the teacher entered the classroom, all the worksheets had been handed out.I'm sure you have more interesting sentences to share.In the interaction session, work with your classmates.Ask them what they wrote about.Write down their sentences in the worksheet.And pick the most interesting one to report to the class.Here are the assignments for today.Finish the grammar exercises on pages 30 to 31 in the workbook.Think about situations where passive forms are preferred over active forms.Give three examples.That's it for today's period.Thanks for watching.
